summary:
Do your Apple Watch bands no longer lock in, or is the release button stuck? Has a strap come off on its own?

The band mechanism takes a load every time you swap straps, and over the years the pins tire and the lug springs wear out. We replace the lug mechanism with OEM-grade parts, usually on the same day.

It's one of our quickest repairs. It costs R250 for Series 1 to 3, R350 for Series 4 to 9, SE and SE 2, R450 for Series 10, Series 11 and SE 3, and R600 for Ultra models.

Every job starts with a free diagnostic. Visit us at Silvercrest Shopping Centre.

Tap Call now to speak to us about your repair.
